messages:
rika: heads-up: deploy-bot throttled v4.0.0 on /embeddings (traffic -> 30%). p95 jumped ~+50%. options: wait, route-split to v3.9.8, or rollback. ops?

deploy-bot: [automated] Throttle applied to rollout v4.0.0. Trigger: embeddings_p95_delta >= 45% over 5m. Suggested: wait 10m; split traffic to fallback; manual rollback to v3.9.8.

ops-oncall: i'm online. prefer scoped split first to reduce customer impact. if no improvement in 12m, execute rollback.

sam: i can do 85/15 split (v4.0.0/v3.9.8) for embeddings in ~4m and prep pin command. also prepare rollback snippet: ```/deploy rollback --service=embeddings --to=v3.9.8 --reason="perf regression"```

lee: drafting a short customer note: "We applied a temporary traffic reduction for embeddings due to increased latency; monitoring now." will post if we change customer-facing routing.

rika: sam, cut the split. ops, mark autorevert suppressed for this thread. i'll watch traces.

deploy-bot: [system] Autorevert suppressed by operator request. Autorevert window paused until 4371238200.

sam: split applied: 85% -> v4.0.0, 15% -> v3.9.8. verification: no 5xx, logs look normal for fallback path.

ops-oncall: t+6m update: p95 dropped from +50% -> +32%. trending down but still above threshold. hold to t+12m. if p95 > +25% then rollback.

rika: thanks. if we rollback, let's pin v3.9.8 for affected tenants and include rollback note in release notes. lee, keep the draft ready.

lee: done 14; pinging legal for wording.

sam: standing by to execute rollback if ops calls it.

ops-oncall: will call rollback at t+12m if no steady improvement. current plan: graduated rampback after 30m of p95 < +20%.

rika: copy. reconvene at t+12m.
